verses.en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.sm: Nopa. Isaraelu O savaliga ia a le fanauga a Isaraelu, e na o mai mai 10 aai o lairo. le nuu o Aikupito, i a latou “au i le pule a Mose ma Arona.

verses.en: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.sm: Na tusia e Mose o mea na latou o mai ai i o latou savaliga e tusa ma le afioga a le ALII. O latou savaliga ia i mea na latou o mai ai.

verses.en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.sm: Na o mai i latou mai Ramese i le masina muamua, i le aso e sefulu ma le lima o le masina muamua; o le aso ua aupito mai i le paseka na o mai ai le fanauga a Isaraelu ma le lima malosi i luma o Aikupito uma.

verses.en: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
verses.sm: Auá na tatanu e Aikupito o ulumatua uma na fasiotia e le ALII ia te i latou; na faasalaina foi e le ALII o latou atua.

verses.en: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.sm: Na o mai le fanauga a Isaraelu mai Ramese, ma latou to lauapi i Sukota.

verses.en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Sukota, ma latou to lauapi i Etama, o loo tupito i le vao.

verses.en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Etama, ona toe foi atu lea i Peairota, ua fesagai ma Paalasefona, ma latou to lauapi i luma o Mekatala.

verses.en: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai luma o Airota, ona latou ui atu lea i totonu o le sami i le vao. e tolu aso o la latou malaga i le vao o Etama, ona latou to lauapi ai lea i Mara.

verses.en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Mara, ona oo mai ai lea o i latou i Ailima; ua i Ailima o vaipuna e sefulu ma le lua, ma pama e fitugafulu; ua latou to lauapi ai.

verses.en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Ailima, ma latou to lauapi e latalata ane i le sami Ulaula.

verses.en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai le sami Ulaula, ma latou to lauapi i le vao o Sina.

verses.en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai le vao o Sina, ma latou to lauapi i Tapeka.

verses.en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Tapeka, ma latou to lauapi i Alusa.

verses.en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Alusa, ma latou to lauapi i Refiti; sa leai se vai i lea mea e feinu ai le nuu.

verses.en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Refiti, ma latou to lauapi i le vao o Sinai.

verses.en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai le vao o Sinai, ma latou to lauapi i Kiperota-atava.

verses.en: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Kiperota-atava, ma latou to lauapi i Haserota.

verses.en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Haserota, ma latou to lauapi i Ritima.

verses.en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Ritima, ma latou to lauapi i Rimoni-paresa.

verses.en: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Rimoni-paresa, ma latou to lauapi i Lipena.

verses.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Lipena, ma latou to lauapi i Risa.

verses.en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Risa, ma latou to lauapi i Kailata.

verses.en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Kailata, ma latou to lauapi i le mauga o Sapera.

verses.en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai le mauga o Sapera, ma latou to lauapi i Harata.

verses.en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Harata, ma latou to lauapi i Makelota.

verses.en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Makelota, ma latou to lauapi i Taata.

verses.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Taata, ma latou to lauapi i Tara.

verses.en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Tara, ma latou to lauapi i Meteka.

verses.en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Meteka, ma latou to lauapi i Hasamoni.

verses.en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Hasamoni, ma latou to lauapi i Moserota.

verses.en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Moserota, ma latou to lauapi Peneakana.

verses.en: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Peneakana, ma latou to lauapi i Horokikata.

verses.en: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Horokikata, ma latou to lauapi i latepata.

verses.en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai latepata, ma latou to lauapi Aperona.

verses.en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Aperona, ma latou to lauapi Esiokape.

verses.en: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Esiokape, ma latou to lauapi i le vao o Tisina, o Katesa lea.

verses.en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Katesa, ma latou to lauapi i le mauga o Horo, i le pito nuu o Etoma.

verses.en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.sm: Na alu ae Arona le ositaulaga i lc mauga o Horo, e tusa ma le afioga a le ALII, ona ou ai lea o ia i lea mea i le tausaga e fagafulu talu ona o mai o le fanauga a Isaraelu ai le nuu o Aikupito, i le aso muamua o le masina e lima.

verses.en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.sm: E tasi le selau ma le luafulu ma le tolu o tausaga O Arona ina ua oti o ia ile mauga o Horo.

verses.en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Na faalogo le tupu o Arata, o le sa Kanana, o le na nofo i Kanana, i le itu i toga, ua o mai le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai le mauga o Horo, ma latou to lauapi i Salemoni.

verses.en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Salemoni, ma latou to lauapi i Pinono.

verses.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Pinono, ma latou to lauapi i Opoto.

verses.en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Opoto, ma latou to lauapi i Ieaperima, o i le tuaoi o Moapi.

verses.en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai lima, ma latou to lauapi i Tipona-kato.

verses.en: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Tipona-kato, ma latou to lauapi i Alemonitipelata.

verses.en: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai Alemoni-tipelata, ma latou to lauapi i mauga o Aperima, e feagai ma Nepo.

verses.en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.sm: Na latou o mai mai mauga o Aperima, ma latou to lauapi i le eleele laugatasi o Moapi, e latalata ane i Ioritana e fesagai ma Ieriko.

verses.en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.sm: Na to lauapi i latou E latalata ane i Ioritana, pau mai i Petesemota, pau mai i Apelasetima, i le eleele laugatasi o Moapi.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le ALI ia Mose i le eleele laugatasi o Moapi, e latalata ane i Ioritana, e fesagai ma Ieriko, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.sm: la e fai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia te i latou, A outou oo atu i lela itu o Ioritana i le nuu o Kanana,

verses.en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.sm: ona outou tulia ai lea o e o nonofo i le nuu uma lava ai o outou luma, ia outou faaumatia a latou faatagata uma lava, ia faaumatia foi e outou a latou tupua uamea lava; o a latou mea maualuluga uma lava tou te matua faaumatia.

verses.en: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.sm: Ia tulia e outou le nuu, ma outou nonofo ai; auā ua ou tuuina atu le nuu ia te outou e fai mo outou tofi.

verses.en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.sm: ‘Tou te tofitofi le nuu i le vili e fai ma tofi i o outou aiga; o e toatele ia outou avatu i ai le tofi ia tele; a o e toaitiiti, ia outou avatu i ai le tofi ia itiiti; o le mea e faasaga iai le vili a le tagata e fai lea mona, e maua o outou tofi i itu aiga O outou tama.

verses.en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.sm: A e afai tou te le tulia i o outou luma o e o nonofo i le nuu, ona avea lea o i latou o e ua outou faatotoeina, ma mea matuitui i o outou mata, ma laau talatala i o outou itu, ma latou faatiga ia te outou i le nuu tou te nonofo ai.

verses.en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.sm: E iu foi ina ou faia ia te outou e faapei ona ou manatu e fai ia te i latou.
